overview: In the Lion Unleashed series, we look back at the Dutch driver's World Championship successes which has kept him at the very top four years in a row.
title: Verstappen Lion Unleashed

overview: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.
title: Miss King

overview: An unprecedented backstage pass alongside Taylor Swift as her record-breaking tour comes to an end.
title: The End of an Era

overview: Four uncompromising girls take on the male-dominated sports of motorsports, where one mistake can ruin a career, battling the clock, their competitors and themselves.
title: Raske jenter

overview: Strangers is a UK police drama that appeared on ITV between 1978 and 1982.
title: Strangers

overview: What happens when Swedes leave their everyday routines behind to embrace the charter life of sunbathing, humid evenings out and fast-paced adventures? We find the answers in söta bror's edition of Charterfeber.
title: Charterfeber Sverige

overview: Jan Åge Fjørtoft meets famous personalities who are in one way or another connected to international football. There will be anecdotes, reminiscences and a wealth of unknown stories.
title: Jan Åges Unplugged

overview: Get a rare and completely unique insight into a world full of magic and spirituality, when eight spiritual guides open the door to their work with everything from palm reading and crystals to soul journeys and contact with the deceased.
title: Spirituelle Stjerner

overview: This is an honest story about MMA fighter Nicolas Dalby's violent decline, from successful UFC fighter to depressed and unemployed, as well as his struggle to get back on track both personally and professionally. Premiered in 2019.
title: Fighting Nicolas Dalby

overview: Rare videos and exclusive interviews reveal the genius, sacrifices and duality between the public and private lives of iconic singer-songwriter Juan Gabriel.
title: Juan Gabriel: Debo, puedo y quiero

overview: The workshop is a place where cool toys and funny inventions are created from the most ordinary things that everyone has at home!
title: Мастерская

overview: A mother faces stigma and a painful separation when her husband takes their children abroad, forever changing her life. Based on a true story.
title: Nadie nos vio partir

overview: Join TV 2's crime reporters behind the scenes in their coverage of the biggest crime cases.
title: Etterforsket

overview: As a family get stuck in a charming village of the French coutryside, a string of unexpected events triggers an investigation that tears them appart and threatens to expose their terrible secret: they can only feed on human flesh.
title: La famille Rose

overview: The Railway Children concerns a family who move to "Three Chimneys", a house near the railway, after the father, who works at the Foreign office, is imprisoned after being falsely accused of spying. The children befriend an Old Gentleman who regularly takes the 9:15 train near their home; he is eventually able to help prove their father's innocence, and the family is reunited.
title: The Railway Children

overview: A woman loses herself by playing the "perfect girlfriend," cooking elaborate meals for her partner, while her old-fashioned boyfriend assumes women should cook. After a smooth college romance and cohabitation, they break up right after his proposal. Through cooking, they rethink stereotypes and rebuild their love in this rom-com.
title: So, You Make It

overview: Belgium, early 1980s. Jan Laureys wants to see the world and enjoy life, but reluctantly becomes a national police officer. His father, himself an officer in the gendarmerie, wants it that way. When Jan hears about the CDI, a new unit that will tackle drug criminals using American methods, he immediately puts himself forward as a candidate. They don't wear uniforms at the CDI, so he can continue to parade around the courtyard of the barracks in his fashionable outfits.
title: De Big Fuck-Up

overview: Africa's coastlines host diverse marine life, from Atlantic upwellings to Indian Ocean reefs. Yet, human pressures disrupt ecosystems—seals hunt birds due to fish shortages, turtles ingest plastic, and sharks fall victim to protective nets. Aboard the Angra Pequena, scientists and volunteers work to safeguard these waters. Capture this urgent mission in a stunning visual journey.
title: Oceans Africa

overview: Wen Ni and Jian Yu Chen have been incompatible since high school and all the way to work. Everyone thinks that there is no chance for them to be together, but the ridiculous thing is that they have been secretly married for three years. They quarreled fiercely at the company during the day but made love again at night when they got home. They both knew each other tacitly and thought that they were physically compatible until they met Wen Ni's first love, Shen Huai Xu, at work. Jian Yu Chen's jealousy grew wildly. In order to prevent Wen Ni and Shen Huai Xu from rekindling their old love, Jian Yu Chen openly confessed his love to Wen Ni at his alma mater's anniversary celebration and made public their married relationship. Wen Ni then realized that Jian Yu Chen had been planning this for a long time and had been secretly in love with her for many years.
title: Ling Du Ai Mei

overview: A story about three completely different men who are forced to live under one roof in a rented apartment. Their secrets, dreams, and everyday troubles become the source of countless comic situations, revealing their contrasting lifestyles and interactions with the world around them. Despite all the household and personal challenges, the heroes learn to value friendship, overcome stress, and always find a reason to laugh.
title: Життя на трьох

overview: Sexy singles venture into the woods to compete for love, sex and a 100k grand prize. Hosted by Ray J and Narrated by Tia Kemp.
title: Love Cabin

overview: Three Up, Two Down is a British sitcom starring Michael Elphick and Angela Thorne that ran for 4 seasons from April 15, 1985 - June 18, 1989. Nick and Angie have just had a baby, and to help them financially they decide to rent out the basement. Both Nick's father, Sam Tyler, and Angie's mother, Daphne Trenchard, want the basement apartment and the only solution is to share. Sam is a Cockney, while Daphne is Cheltenham-bred and has not forgiven her daughter for marrying Nick, a 'common' photographer. Both Sam and Daphne are widowed, and stubborn.
title: Three Up, Two Down

overview: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.
title: Зрадники
Qia Si Liu Huo Ru Han Yuan

overview: A domineering beauty boss meets her polished overseas-returnee secretary in the high-stakes corporate arena. Forced to collaborate, their initial friction sparks an unexpected romance, leading them from workplace rivals to lifetime partners.
title: Dear Secretary

overview: Based on true events, this drama series follows socialite Ângela Diniz, whose murder trial becomes a landmark in the country's history.
title: Ângela Diniz: Assassinada e Condenada

overview: Sengoku Akira, a chiropractor, doesn't know the first thing about raising a child. But when his ex-girlfriend suddenly entrusts him with their daughter, Airi, he's thrust into the deep end. So he moves in with his friend Harumi Masahiro – a divorced manga editor with a young son of his own. In exchange for rent, Akira cooks all their meals. After all, how hard can it be?
title: Papa and Daddy's Home Cooking

overview: A1 Grand Prix (A1GP) was a single make open wheel auto racing series. It was unique in its field in that competitors solely represented their nation as opposed to themselves or a team, the usual format in most formula racing series. As such, it was often promoted as the "World Cup of Motorsport". The series was ratified by the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA) and races were held in the traditional Formula One off-season.
title: A1 Grand Prix

overview: 12 stars, no experience in the wilderness and a million euros. The perfect combination for an adventure of a different kind. But because that's not enough, the mountain keeper also has a whole host of challenges at the start that will put the celebrities to the test, both physically and mentally. Who will manage to climb the summit and go home with up to one million euros at the end?
title: The Summit

overview: Twelve unknown Dutch people take on the ultimate challenge in Scandinavia to reach a remote mountain top within twelve days. With backpacks filled with a part of a quarter of a million euros, they have to reach the finish line. Those who give up on the way leave the mountain with his part of the money. Along the way, the mysterious Mountain keeper puts the participants to the test.
title: The Summit

overview: Jiang Wu has always lived in fear of debt collectors due to her father's disappearance, until she meets Jiang Yan, a silent man always covered in wounds, who takes her in and protects her. What she does not know is that he is actually an undercover police officer named Lu Xiao, who has infiltrated a border town gang incognito. The two lonely souls grow closer, yet she can never see through the mist in his eyes. At a critical juncture of his mission, he leaves without a word, leaving only some money and a letter telling her to forget him. Four years later, she becomes a reporter for North City TV, while he, retired due to injuries, runs a homestay called "Yearning for Wu." Fate brings them together again—she arrives with an interview list, and he calmly says he is Lu Xiao. Be it Jiang Yan or Lu Xiao, he remains an indelible part of her life. After years of hating him and searching for him, she now realizes that him keeping secrets and pushing her away are just to protect her.
title: Embrace You Through the Ashes

overview: "Flight with Taste" is a gastronomic travel show, in each episode of which an eminent chef and a popular blogger travel to different cities of the world to discover the main tastes of the region for the audience. Their adventure begins already on board the plane. The chef creates a special menu inspired by the destination, and at the end of the issue, the blogger and chef will prepare a gala dinner based on the trip.
title: Полёт со вкусом

overview: The series will explore a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, ‘Everybody counts or nobody counts.'
title: Bosch: Start of Watch

overview: Horvatovi is a family drama TV Show with strong elements of humor. It is an adaptation of a popular spanish show "Los Serrano".
title: Horvatovi

overview: The modern-day divine doctor Lin Wanrou responds to the plea of the vengeful spirit of another Lin Wanrou, who died tragically in a different world. Activating the Book of Fate, she travels to that world on the very day of the other Lin Wanrou's wedding, determined to "defy destiny and rewrite her fate"! In the marquis's household, wolves lurk on all sides, each harboring their own schemes. Faced with deliberate humiliation and repeated traps from Xiao Yuan, Su Meier, her stepmother, and even the rest of the household, Lin Wanrou uses her intelligence and wit to resolve every crisis with ease. With her exceptional medical skills, she cures Xiao Yu's leg ailment and purges deadly poison. She also opens free clinics, rescues the declining Baicaotang medical hall, and revitalizes the marquis family's enterprises!
title: A Prescription for Revenge

overview: When Nelly suspects Wessam, her husband Tariq's friend, of harassing her stepson, she takes a stand—triggering a chain of events that lands the perpetrator in a coma and puts Tariq behind bars.
title: Lam Shamsia

overview: Uzaki Ryo is a rookie lawyer who is reckless but full of a sense of justice. After losing his father in an accident five years ago, Uzaki quit his job as a salaryman and decided to pursue a career in law. Although he finally passed the bar exam with great effort, he was rejected from every law firm interview and spent his days working part-time jobs. Just when he thought his luck had changed, he unexpectedly secured a job at "Peace Law Firm." He believed this was his chance to become a proper lawyer, but "Peace Law Firm" was not a place where lawyers waited for clients to come to them. Instead, it was an office full of lawless lawyers who infiltrated places where disputes were smoldering, stirring up lawsuits among the people.
title: Ignite: Ho no Muhomono

overview: A highly intelligent marine mechanical engineer named (Asfour) was able to form a large company, an import, export and maritime transport company with branches in various countries of the world, and with it social and human relations in his life. His life is characterized by the multiplicity of his feminine and emotional relationships, he discovers that he has children of multinationals from his multiple marriages.
title: 9 Gameat El Dowal

overview: The series follows Maryam, who is attached to her family and always helps them. As she always puts the happiness of those around her ahead of hers, something happens that changes her life completely and makes her rethink her way of living.
title: Nekdeb Law Qolna Mabenhebesh

overview: The mini series features the Egyptian revolution on the 25th January 2011, portraying 3 young friends going through financial and social difficulties so they decide to revolt against the system, also demonstrating the face book revolution and how demonstrating in Tahrir square was organized. It even portrays the marriage that occurred in Tahrir Square during the revolution all the way up till the stepping down of the president.
title: Citizen X

overview: Hanamura Aiko is a skilled lawyer who specializes in divorce cases. She is a warm-hearted person who sympathizes with clients who are suffering from marital problems, but she grew up seeing her parents' discord, and has lost faith in romance and love. She dotes on her recently adopted dog, Sakura, and is enjoying her single life.
title: Love is for the Dogs

overview: Andrija and Anđelka, a couple in their mid thirties, are a typical example of what happens when a man and woman live together. Although they are sincerely in love with each other, they often get on each others nerves, whether in the bedroom, a supermarket or a dinner with friends.
title: Andrija i Anđelka

overview: A romantic comedy drama and suspenseful mystery about a top star lawyer who has been a die-hard fan for 15 years, and an idol who hates his obsessive fans.
title: Idol I

overview: A romance between a single woman who pretends to be a married mom in order to get a job, and the team leader who falls in love with her.
title: Dynamite Kiss

overview: This bold and provocative four-part series asks the question – What is the idea of Australia and how might we learn from the past to make it stronger in the 21st century?
title: The Idea of Australia

overview: From the pinnacle of athletic success to the depths of scandal, Alex Rodriguez saw his prolific baseball career marred by a high-profile suspension for performance-enhancing drug use. Told through a series of intimate interviews with Rodriguez, Alex vs ARod explores the dualities of one of the most polarizing figures in sports. With the benefit of hindsight and years of intense self-examination, Rodriguez confronts the personal struggles and controversies that shaped his journey from "Alex," a baseball prodigy abandoned by his father, to "A-Rod," the decorated MLB superstar driven by a relentless pursuit of greatness, no matter the cost. Featuring insights from family, friends, teammates, and broadcasters, the series examines the events that fueled Rodriguez's rise and fall, as well as his extraordinary talent, his place in baseball history, and the personal growth that defines his life as "Alex" today.
title: Alex vs ARod

overview: Marines is a coming-of-age docuseries following the members of the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU), the US military's "force in readiness" in the Pacific. With unparalleled access to the US Marine Corps, the series offers an inside look into the rigorous trainings and emotional moments of young Marines as they forge bonds while grappling with the complexities of life at sea.
title: Marines

overview: 1994. Twelve-year-old Vasya and seven-year-old Nadya are sent to live with their uncle's family after their parents are killed by creditors for unpaid debts. Their father tried to start his own business and paid for it with his life. Their uncle, the deceased's brother, is a former party worker who hid from reality in alcohol. Vasya and Nadya decide to escape from a family where scandals and fights are the norm and start a new life in Moscow. Ten years later, they still have not forgotten their difficult childhood.
title: Брат и сестра

overview: The Innocence Project follows a group of bright and ambitious law students. Champion of the underdog and a brilliant teacher, Professor Jon Ford sets up The Innocence Project, peopled entirely by a hand-picked group of law students. His passion for his subject ignites something new and exciting in his students. They take on cases pro bono that nobody else wants to know about. Smart and with an infectious enthusiasm, Ford's team is made up of fresh-faced 19-year-old university students who choose to make a difference while still going through the serious business of growing up. Their job is part investigator, part lawyer - and all before they're out of full-time education. The Innocence Project is about the law - but not about lawyers and the police; it's about failures in the process and cracks in the system. It's about young people with fire in their bellies and a healthy disregard for...
title: The Innocence Project

overview: Construction Stress from A to Z: Andy and his family build their house, from plan to finish.
title: Andy en de Baksteen Belgen
Huang Jin Pi De Gu Shi

overview: The Grimleys is a comedy set in the 1970s at an English School. Gordon Grimley, a young but misfit schoolboy is in love with his English teacher, Geraldine Titley. Unfortunately Geraldine is in love with sadistic teacher Doug Digby. The show follows Gordon and his family as he struggles for Geraldine's attention.
title: The Grimleys

overview: Liu Jingl struggles after her 18-year-old daughter, Zhou Yi, disappears. An unexpected discovery pulls Liu Jingli into the past, joined by her friend Xu Xiaofeng to uncover the truth behind the mysterious circumstances surrounding Zhou Yi's fate. The search for answers also brings in journalist Liu Xiulian, the adoptive mother of Zhou Yi's classmate, Li Sibo. Li Sibo appears gentle and kind, seemingly helpful in uncovering the truth, but his own secrets gradually surface, linking him to Zhou Yi's past and revealing the complexities of his relationship with his mother. Told across two timelines, blending past and present, the story follows the three women as they peel back layers of complex family dynamics, unsettling truths about certain aspects of Zhou Yi's past, and the secrets surrounding Li Sibo. As the investigation deepens, bringing shocking revelations that deeply affect the families, the search for answers leads to the truth behind Zhou Yi's fate.
title: Yi Lu Can Lan

overview: Imai Karen is a 29 year old cosmetics company employee, who has been unable to find true love due to a past trauma. While playing around with many men in her life, Karen meets Teito, a college student with zero experience in love at a drinking party. After noticing Teito, who is not intimidated by her "flirtatious techniques", Karen decides to try everything to get him to fall for her.
title: Toshishita Cherry Boy-kun ni Honrou Saretemasu

overview: new grandiose vocal project, which will meet the triumphant, finalists and just bright talented heroes of the most popular music shows of the country. They will return to the stage to restart their careers, remind everyone what they are capable of, and compete for the love of the audience and the title of the winner.
title: Браво! Бис!
Min Guo Qi Tan Zhi Qi Yuan Zhen Tan

overview: A combination of humor and analysis, which tries to explain reality in a simple, fun and factual way.
title: Programa Cautelar

overview: After a tax accountant's dream of joining his father's firm falls apart, he meets a wealthy horse owner and gets drawn into the world of horse racing.
title: Passing the Reins

overview: Can women in their 40s still treat themselves to a little luxury called life? Once a legendary TV home shopping host, Na Jeong is now a stay-at-home mom exhausted by the daily battles of raising two kids. When a small lie unexpectedly lands her back at her old company as an intern host, her world turns upside down. Joo Young, the perfectionist director of an art center, has always kept everything under control until her career and marriage start to crack. And Il Ri, a hopeless romantic and magazine editor, struggles to choose between her ideals and reality. As three friends laugh, cry, and stumble their way through midlife crisis, they rediscover who they are and what truly matters. Perfect or not, their second act might be their best one yet.
title: Don't Call Me Ma'am

overview: Americans throw away $57 billion worth of coupons every year. But for savvy savers, coupons can mean the difference between saving and spending thousands of dollars. On Wednesday, December 29 at 8 PM ET/PT, TLC will introduce four of the country's most coupon-obsessed savers who will do anything for a deal. Their game is simple - get as much as possible for as little as possible. But these extreme couponers aren't just looking to save a few dollars here and there. Instead, they're looking to cash in on some serious savings and they're doing it by any means necessary - dumpster diving for coupons, charting weekly store circulars, creating elaborate math formulas and stocking up on as many products as possible. With over 367 billion coupons printed each year, the addictive art of smart shopping can be an extreme rush for any consumer on Extreme Couponing.
title: Extreme Couponing

overview: For the first time in its history, this quintessentially British institution opens its doors to see a new supercar go from paper to production; the much anticipated, Bentayga. This is car building the hard way: by hand.
title: Inside Bentley: A Great British Motorcar

overview: After making a serious mistake in his work in Tokyo, talented surgeon Goto Kensuke is invited to take charge of the only clinic on the small island of Yonaguni, Okinawa. It is difficult to get competent doctors to serve on this remote island, and the islanders are now used to traveling for hours via boat for proper medical care. Despite seeming weak and unreliable (he gets very seasick, and does not have a driving license), he wins over the skeptical islanders with his skill and dedication. Some children of the island make a flag for his clinic, but get his name wrong. Thereafter he is known by all as Koto.
title: Dr. Coto's Clinic
Gui Mi Shuang Chuan Huang Nian，Gen Zhe Jie Mei Zhuan Da Qian
Spring Breeze That Cust Through the Thorns

overview: During the Daqing era, the Jiang family of the Imperial Medical Bureau suffered a massacre. Consort Yi, seeking the heart's blood of someone born in a "yin year and yin day" to refine an elixir, killed Madam Jiang as she tried to protect her daughters. With her dying breath, Madam Jiang instructed Jiang Wei and Jiang Yan to conceal their birth dates and protect each other for life. Ten years later, the sisters entered the palace disguised as medical attendants to avenge their family. Jiang Yan planned to win the emperor's attention with the Red Plum Dance, while Jiang Wei secured her position by solving the emperor's dilemma through the "Seven-Star Radiance Formation." The harem was rife with danger. Consort Yi forced Jiang Wei to destroy Jiang Yan's appearance, but Jiang Wei disfigured herself instead to protect her. The empress forged letters to frame the sisters for conspiring with Prince Yan in rebellion. To survive, the sisters staged a falling-out: Jiang Yan won favor and was granted the title of consort to restrain their enemies, while Jiang Wei worked in the shadows, collaborating with Prince Yan, who held military power, to uncover the truth: their father had been falsely accused of treason, and it had actually been the emperor who used the Prince of Zhennan to eliminate loyal officials. At Jiang Yan's coronation ceremony, Jiang Wei appeared with evidence that exposed the emperor's crimes. Prince Yan led his troops to seize control of the imperial guards, and the emperor abdicated. Five years later, Jiang Yan governed as regent to the young emperor, while Jiang Wei married Prince Yan. The sisters finally cleared their family's name, and each found their own happiness
title: Twin Blossoms in the Palace
Koifure ~ Koibito Miman ga Choudo ii

overview: An Angel Eater has been freed in Heaven. Since Goddesses and Angels share body and soul, losing your angel results in going into shock for the Goddess. Lind goes to Earth to protect Belldandy and the others unknowing that it is a trap. This is 20th Anniversary 2-part special that continues on the TV anime.
title: Ah! My Goddess: Fighting Wings
